10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor thematic/resource exposure and EM via XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +2.15%) and EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.34% | 1M: +5.05%), reduce exposure to Tech XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -0.09%) and duration TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -1.62%); monitor credit via HYG (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +0.54%) vs LQD (1W: -0.44% | 1M: -0.29%).

Key risk is rising credit stress (HYG (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +0.54%) vs LQD (1W: -0.44% | 1M: -0.29%)) and widespread CORRECTION mismatches across SPY, XBI and GLD to monitor.
